new_negative_result_and_fix.finding: Absolute temporary sandbox root was persisted in semantic effect state, so semantically identical effects under different roots produced different semantic and trace hashes.
new_negative_result_and_fix.resolution: Persist only normalized relative_path and sandbox:/// logical target_identity; keep host root outside semantic state.
new_negative_result_and_fix.post_fix_test: Two distinct temporary roots executing the same logical effect now produce identical semantic_state_hash and trace_root_hash, and neither absolute root appears in the materialized effect value.

previous_effect_reentry_fix_retained.finding: Broad bounded effect-domain retrieval caused only 23/100 wrapper audit passes as history grew.
previous_effect_reentry_fix_retained.resolution: Effect outcome re-entry is exact-key addressed by effect_id.
